description: Scope: what this repository pins. Workflow actions by commit, the Docker images by digest, uv, and the Python packages in pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Security fixes come from Dependabot security updates (a repository setting), which Renovate would raise a second time. The driver.js files in nih_grant_matcher/ui/vendor are copied by hand and are not moved.

packageRules.description: Workflow actions: one PR, each pinned to a commit with its tag in a comment
The image runs Python 3.13, which CI also tests. Only a rebuilt digest of that tag moves here. Raise the tag by hand together with the CI matrix.
A rebuilt digest of the Python base image
streamlit, pandas and pytest, with the versions uv.lock resolves for them, in one PR
PyInstaller and pywebview build the macOS app. Their own PR, so that the macos-build.yml check on it tests only them.
The hadolint and Trivy images, in the same PR as the workflow actions
uv is pinned in the Dockerfile and in tests.yml. Move both in one PR. Last, so that it overrides the groups above.

customManagers.description: The hadolint and Trivy images docker-image.yml runs
